description: This PHP source file defines the Dashboard class inside the Opencart admin extension controller namespace. It manages dashboard extension modules including listing, installation, and uninstallation functionalities, with methods to handle permissions, loading extensions, and generating views.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard extensions within the Opencart admin system. Handles listing, installation, uninstallation, and permission validation for dashboard modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Outputs the list of dashboard extensions by calling getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads language files, reads available extension files, compares installed extensions, prepares data for the view, and returns the rendered dashboard extension list.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks user permission to modify dashboard extensions; returns boolean indicating permission status.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a dashboard extension, including permission setup, autoload registration, and invoking optional extension-specific install procedures.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a dashboard extension, permission checks, and calls extension-specific uninstall procedures.
